quantity: firn air content anomaly from GEMB, per ice sheet domain and time step
units: value_m and uncertainty_m in metres of air (area-weighted mean over the domain); volume_km3 in km3 of air; area_km2 in km2
sign_convention: positive is more air in the firn column (a thicker column at unchanged mass)
not_in_the_distribution: Antarctica, grounded ice sheet: no GEMB firn air content field is distributed with ITS_LIVE on AWS (the bucket was listed under height_change, mass_change, ice_masks and documentation); the Antarctic rows cover the floating ice shelves
alternates_not_read: RACMO2 (IMAU regional climate model firn and surface mass balance output): not read
MAR (regional climate model surface mass balance output): not read
the IMBIE basin definitions: not read; the products' own masks partition the grids

greenland.product: ITS_LIVE Greenland Grounded Ice Sheet and Peripheral Glacier Ice Elevation Change
greenland.variable_comment: Resampled firn air content anomaly (dfac_gemb) w.r.t. to 2014-01-01: GEMB Version 1.3.0
greenland.forcing: not stated in the file's attributes; no product documentation for this file was found on nsidc.org or in the ITS_LIVE bucket, so the forcing of the GEMB 1.3.0 run is left unstated here rather than assumed
greenland.grid: 1920 m polar stereographic, EPSG:3413, 1421 by 783 cells; cell areas from the projection's areal scale
greenland.mask: the file's mask variable: 1 ice sheet, 2 peripheral glacier, 0 non-ice; the ice sheet domain is the grounded ice sheet, the product being a grounded ice elevation change product
greenland.aggregation: area-weighted mean over the fixed set of cells inside the mask that are finite in dfac_gemb and dfac_gsfc at every time step; the same anomaly integrated to km3 of air
greenland.reference: anomaly against 2014-01-01, the product's own reference
greenland.uncertainty_basis: model spread: the absolute difference between the GEMB 1.3.0 and the GSFC-FDM 1.2.1 aggregates the file carries (dfac_gemb, dfac_gsfc); the product ships no firn error field

antarctica.product: MEaSUREs ITS_LIVE Antarctic Ice Shelf Height Change and Basal Melt Rates, Version 1
antarctica.forcing: 3-hourly ERA5 reanalysis, 1979 to 2017, after a relaxation simulation (the NSIDC-0792 user guide, section 2.3.1.3)
antarctica.grid: 1920 m polar stereographic, EPSG:3031, 2916 by 2916 cells; cell areas from the projection's areal scale; the user guide says the GEMB fields were interpolated from a 5 km grid
antarctica.mask: the file's ID variable: ice shelf identifiers 1 to 182 (an edited MEaSUREs Antarctic Boundaries version 2), land 255; the domain is the floating ice shelves only, since no GEMB field over grounded Antarctica is in the ITS_LIVE distribution
antarctica.aggregation: area-weighted mean over the fixed set of ice shelf cells finite in fac at every time step and in fac_mean; the anomaly integrated to km3 of air; fac_err is read only for the statistics in the stamp, where it is finite and below its sentinel
antarctica.reference: anomaly against the product's fac_mean (its 1992 to 2017 record mean), whose area-weighted mean over the cell set is 14.901947 m
antarctica.sampling: quarterly: one row per product time step, labelled by the calendar month of the time value (the user guide calls it the quarter start date)
antarctica.uncertainty_basis: stated noise floor: standard deviation of adjacent-step differences of the finished anomaly series divided by sqrt(2), written on every row; the product's fac_err is not used because its values (tens of metres at the median, 9999 where it has none) and its units attribute (m of ice per year, where the user guide gives m) do not read as a firn air content error

fac_err_not_used.per_step: [label, cells at or above the 9999 sentinel or not finite, percentiles 1, 50 and 99 of the rest over the fixed cell set]
